queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller,x->>'definition_md5' historical_md5 FROM public.lf_eventos l,jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161), live AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname caller,md5(p.prosrc) current_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace) SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NULL) absent,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5=live.current_md5) eq_true,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5<>live.current_md5) eq_false FROM h LEFT JOIN live USING(caller);

SELECT jsonb_array_length(payload->'sql_callers') callers,jsonb_array_length(payload->'trigger_bindings') triggers,jsonb_array_length(payload->'external_inventory') external,payload->'historical_provenance_only' limits FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161;
queries.result: callers=38,triggers=21,external=6; source says readiness 5.12 vs governed 5.13 is provenance/currentness drift and older contract existence is not caller-usage evidence.

assumptions: snapshot is valid only for its observation time
md5(prosrc) equality is an empirical comparator, not proof of historical hash recipe

nogoods.reason: historical construction method is not demonstrated

invariants.rule: callers/triggers/external remain separate identity domains unless mapped
invariants.counterexample: append external rows to caller count

findings.claim: Historical/current comparator reconciles 38 callers into 16 empirical equal and 22 empirical changed with zero absent names.
